description: Add a new person to the user's workspace with a name and, optionally, type labels the person has shared themselves (MBTI, DISC, Enneagram). Birthdate, attachment style and scores are never saved here — use invite_person so the person answers for themselves. Returns the new profile id. Costs 1 unit.

attachment_style.description: Ignored and never saved — the person adds this themselves via invite_person.

date_of_birth.description: Ignored and never saved — the person adds this themselves via invite_person.

department.description: Optional team or department, used by score_team, prep_meeting and suggest_lead.

disc_type.description: Optional DISC style (D, I, S, C or a blend), only if the person shared it themselves.

email.description: Optional email; used to match results if they later take the assessment.

enneagram_type.description: Optional Enneagram type 1-9, only if the person shared it themselves.

eq_score.description: Ignored and never saved — scores come only from the person's own assessment.

mbti_type.description: Optional four-letter MBTI type, only if the person shared it themselves.

name: create_profile
title: Add a person
